entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Wayne Lotter was a South African wildlife conservationist. Lotter was one of the co-founders of the PAMS Foundation, a non profit conservation organisation based in Tanzania. Lotter also previously served as Vice President of the International Ranger Federation.
